conversation:
Maya (CS): Quick status check for Cloverlane private/VPC deploy — they want a week-2 cutover (target 2024-11-12). Main open items: TLS egress to their SIEM, KMS cross-account grant, IAM role mapping for log ingestion, and CloudTrail/S3 retention. Any updates?

Kofi (Network): Working on NAT/SNAT plan. We're proposing shared NAT GW with fixed SNAT ranges. Will publish the IP blocks and a tiny runbook (what to allow on their firewall) by EOD. If they have an egress proxy we might need a bypass.

Kofi (Network): Quick customer test to validate: from a pod in their VPC run `nc -vz siem.cloverlane.net 443` or `curl -I https://siem.cloverlane.net`. Paste output here so we can confirm routing and TLS handshake.

Priya (Security): KMS: I reviewed their requested key. They'll need a key policy grant for the deploy role in their account. Suggest the principal be `arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/cloverlane-redwood-deploy`. Minimal actions: `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey`. Recommend adding a `kms:ViaService` condition scoped to the region.

Priya (Security): Draft snippet (customer can paste into their policy):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodDeployRole",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/cloverlane-redwood-deploy"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

Priya (Security): Also: ask them whether they require HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM / AWS KMS with custom key store). If yes, call that out — it's not hard but changes key provisioning timeline.

Leo (SRE): Audit/logs: two supported patterns — 1) CloudTrail/Flow logs -> S3 bucket (recommended for long retention + audits), or 2) TLS syslog push to customer SIEM (near real-time). For TLS push we need their collector IPs, port, and cert fingerprint. For S3 we need the bucket name and a bucket policy or cross-account write principal.

Leo (SRE): If they want to smoke-test ingestion, I can stand up a temporary intake in our staging and provide an endpoint. For S3 tests we just need a bucket name and a pre-provisioned write role `arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/cloverlane-log-writer` that our account can assume (`sts:AssumeRole`).

Maya (CS): Heads-up on timeline: customer flagged regulatory milestone. If we don't validate connectivity + KMS within 10 business days we need to escalate and discuss a delayed go-live. Please treat the SNAT/IPs and KMS policy as high priority.

Kofi (Network): Confirmed — SNAT IP blocks + runbook by EOD. I'll include notes for proxy-bypass and expected security group entries (outbound 443 to SIEM collector and .io endpoints for our health checks).

Priya (Security): I'll push a full KMS policy example and a brief rotation/HSM checklist by EOD. Also will include an example condition using `kms:ViaService` and region scoping.

Leo (SRE): I'll provision the staging collector tomorrow morning and share the TLS endpoint + cert fingerprint. Will also draft the IAM assume-role JSON we need from the customer for S3 ingestion.

Maya (CS): Action list for clarity: 
- Kofi: publish SNAT IP ranges + NAT/proxy runbook (EOD)
- Priya: publish KMS key policy + rotation/HSM checklist (EOD)
- Leo: spin up staging collector + IAM role spec for S3 (tomorrow morning)
- Maya: confirm HSM preference with Cloverlane and book an enablement call if they want HSM (today)

Maya (CS): I'll assemble a customer-facing email with the attachments and schedule a 48hr follow-up. Renewal-risk note: team flagged that missed regulatory cutover = executive review on their side, so let's try to hit these deliverables. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: note: scheduled maintenance window for redwood-intake-staging on 2024-10-02T03:00:00Z — expect short restart, no disruption to tests if done earlier.

Maya (CS): Thanks all. Drop links to the runbook / policy docs here when ready. Ping me @maya if you want me on the enablement call.
